README Generator

Fill in a form and get a polished README.md with badges, install, usage, and license sections.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your project name, description, and details.
  2. Tick the sections you want included.
  3. Click Generate — copy or download README.md.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I choose which sections to include?

Yes — Installation, Usage, Features, API, Contributing, License, and shields.io badges are all optional checkboxes.

How do I add features?

The Features box takes one feature per line; each becomes a bullet point.

Can I download the README?

Yes — copy the markdown or download it as README.md.

Does it work offline?

Yes — everything stays in your browser.
